summary: Retires DNSSEC Lookaside Validation (DLV) and reclassifies RFC 4431 and RFC 5074 as Historic. It also updates RFC 6698 and RFC 6840 so the DLV record and DLV registries are no longer part of certificate matching or trust anchor selection.

eli5.summary: An old backup way to check a phone book is shut down because the main way works now. This document officially says to stop using the backup.

questions: is dnssec lookaside validation still used
